items.raw_excerpt: Forty years on from Paul Hogan's iconic role as Crocodile Dundee, tourism and production houses are still riding an economic high on its success. But could another box office hit be hard to recreate?
items.summary_en: Forty years after Crocodile Dundee, the Australian outback still benefits from film tourism. Regional filmmakers say new movies could bring similar economic rewards. Experts wonder whether another box office hit from the bush is possible.
items.summary_ko: 크로커다일 던디 이후 40년이 지났지만 호주 내륙 지역은 영화 관광의 경제적 혜택을 여전히 누리고 있다. 지역 영화 제작자들은 새로운 영화가 비슷한 경제적 효과를 가져올 수 있다고 말한다. 전문가들은 호주 시골에서 또다른 흥행작이 나올 수 있을지 주목하고 있다.
items.title_en: Can Australia make another outback film classic?

items.title_original: Can Australia produce another outback film classic?

items.raw_excerpt: The Government is refusing to make any law changes surrounding pork branding but acknowledges some labels may be misleading.
items.summary_en: The New Zealand government says some pork labels in stores may be misleading to shoppers. However, it has decided not to introduce any new laws to fix the problem. Consumer groups had pushed for clearer rules on where pork comes from.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 정부는 일부 돼지고기 제품의 라벨이 소비자에게 혼란을 줄 수 있다고 인정했다. 그러나 이 문제를 해결하기 위한 새 법안은 도입하지 않겠다고 밝혔다. 시민단체들은 돼지고기 원산지 표시를 더 명확히 해야 한다고 촉구해 왔다.
items.title_en: New Zealand government will not change pork labeling rules

items.raw_excerpt: Fisheries Minister V.E. Abdul Gafoor advocates a welfare-oriented approach for the Fisheries department to better serve local fishermen.
items.summary_en: Kerala Fisheries Minister V.E. Abdul Gafoor has called on the Fisheries department to take a welfare-oriented approach. The goal is to better serve local fishermen in the state. The minister emphasized policies that directly benefit fishing communities.

items.summary_en: Homeowners installing solar power systems may get a better return from a slightly bigger system. This article explores whether bigger always means better when choosing solar panel size.

items.summary_en: Chilean footballer Darío Osorio earned his first starting role for Crystal Palace in an EFL Cup match against Middlesbrough. The winger has been working to break into the first team since joining the Premier League club.

items.raw_excerpt: Some non-urgent diagnostic tests will be delayed for two weeks in Manitoba after Dynacare lab workers walked off the job across the province.
items.summary_en: Dynacare lab workers across Manitoba have gone on strike after wage negotiations stalled. The walkout will delay non-urgent diagnostic tests for about two weeks. The union represents the workers in this contract dispute.

items.raw_excerpt: Aquipta atua no bloqueio da transmissão da dor. Estudos apontam que ele é capaz de reduzir “significativamente” o número de dias mensais de enxaqueca.
items.summary_en: Brazil's health agency Anvisa has approved Aquipta, a new drug for migraine treatment. Studies show it can significantly reduce the number of monthly migraine days by blocking pain transmission.

items.raw_excerpt: Canada's men's and women's wheelchair basketball teams hope home-court advantage can help end a lengthy world championship drought.
items.summary_en: Canada's men's and women's wheelchair basketball teams are competing in the world championships in Ottawa. They hope home-court advantage will help them win their first title in many years. The team members have trained hard for this moment.

items.raw_excerpt: Segundo os moradores do bairro da Guabiraba, que precisam atravessar a BR-101 por uma passagem irregular para acessar o Terminal do Córrego do Jenipapo, o número de acidentes aumentou na localidade devido à retirada das lombadas eletrônicas
items.summary_en: Residents of the Guabiraba neighborhood in Recife must cross BR-101 highway through an irregular crossing to reach the Córrego do Jenipapo bus terminal. The removal of electronic speed bumps has caused an increase in accidents at the location. The community is requesting the construction of a pedestrian bridge to improve safety.
